title: Flow Node Body Hover Select
description: When hovering or clicking inside parts of the flow computation node rectangle that are not channels (inputs or outputs), the complete node should be hovered/selected.
summary: At detail/micro LOD, non-channel areas inside computation node rectangles now keep engine node hover/selection instead of being cleared. Removed node_body_hit_excluded and the sync_detail_lod_node_body_hit_exclusion pass; sync_channel_row_pointer_hover only overrides hover when a channel row is hit. Channel rows and handle anchors keep prior handle-level picking.
